entries.prompt: Create a restrained physics textbook illustration, a horizontal triptych of three historically recognizable 19th-century thermodynamics pioneers. Left: Nicolas Léonard Sadi Carnot as a young clean-shaven French man, wavy dark hair, high white collar and black early-1800s coat. Middle: William Thomson, Lord Kelvin as an elderly man with receding white hair, long full white beard and Victorian dark suit. Right: Rudolf Clausius as an older German man with swept back graying hair, strong prominent white moustache and short gray beard, formal dark jacket. Realistic fine engraved charcoal portrait drawings, accurate individual facial structures, busts, consistent scale, quiet off-white background, generous white separation. Not cartoon, not generic identical faces. No decorative frames, no text, no labels. Aspect ratio 3:1. This is newly drawn historical educational illustration, not a photograph.

entries.prompt: Physics textbook historical illustration: Ludwig Boltzmann's memorial at Vienna Central Cemetery, front view, large pale limestone upright arched memorial wall and a dark bronze bust of Ludwig Boltzmann in front of it. Recognizable elderly Boltzmann with round wire spectacles, receding curly hair, full thick beard, formal jacket. Important: upper third of the stone wall is a broad BLANK smooth area above the bust, for a mathematical inscription to be typeset later, so do not draw text or letters anywhere. Realistic hand-drawn charcoal/engraving illustration, neutral monochrome, subtle stone and bronze textures, daylight, no dramatic shadows, no surrounding crowd, quiet clean off-white page background, no frame. Faithful memorial structure, not a generic cartoon head. Vertical 4:5 composition. Newly drawn illustration, not a documentary photograph.

entries.prompt: A physics textbook illustration strip with FOUR separate vignettes on an off-white background, wide horizontal 4:1 aspect ratio. Delicate realistic scientific watercolor with fine charcoal outlines, restrained color, clear recognizable objects, ample whitespace between vignettes. No labels, no numbers, no arrows, no border, no captions, no diagram axes. These will be placed beneath a separate precise atmospheric profile and NOT used to indicate exact altitudes. An original educational illustration, not a photograph.
